title: Game Form Factor Taxonomy
purpose: Data-only taxonomy for presentation modes, view models and asset modes. It does not execute Lua, mutate GamePackage, call providers or generate runtime code.

presentation_modes.title: Top-Down 2D
runtime_implications: Requires tile/sprite refs, collision data and interaction targets.
non_goals: Does not imply final media generation.

presentation_modes.title: Side-View 2D
runtime_implications: Requires side-view layer and interaction-zone export support later.
non_goals: Does not add a side-view runtime in this task.

presentation_modes.title: Isometric 2D
presentation_modes.purpose: Projected 2D/isometric maps for tactical, RPG, city or colony views.
runtime_implications: Needs projection-aware coordinates and sort-layer metadata.
non_goals: Does not implement an isometric renderer.

presentation_modes.title: Tactical Grid 2D
runtime_implications: Requires tactical UI IR and path preview support later.
non_goals: Does not add tactical AI implementation.

presentation_modes.title: First-Person Grid From 2D Textures
presentation_modes.purpose: Dungeon crawler/blobber style view using grid cells, facing, wall textures and billboard actors.
runtime_implications: Future runtime may render a 3D-like view from 2D wall/floor/ceiling texture refs and sprite billboards.
non_goals: Does not store Unity scene objects in GamePackage.

presentation_modes.title: Pseudo-3D Billboard
presentation_modes.purpose: 3D-like presentation built from 2D sprites, billboards and texture refs.
runtime_implications: Future export target maps 2D billboards into a pseudo-3D runtime shell.

presentation_modes.title: First-Person Free Billboard
presentation_modes.purpose: Free first-person navigation with 2D billboard actors and texture refs.
runtime_implications: Requires future free-navigation adapter and collision data contracts.
non_goals: Does not implement an FPS runtime.

presentation_modes.title: UI-Only Text RPG
presentation_modes.purpose: Text, menu, card and dialogue driven game without map rendering requirement.
runtime_implications: Can run with minimal media and strong card/dialogue review surfaces.
non_goals: Does not make LLM a runtime authority.

presentation_modes.title: Map And Panel RPG
presentation_modes.purpose: Map navigation combined with character, party, inventory, dialogue and encounter panels.
runtime_implications: Requires map navigation plus data-driven panel/card UI IR later.
non_goals: Does not hardcode one party UI.

asset_modes.title: No Media Placeholders
asset_modes.purpose: Supports text/data prototypes with fallback labels or ids.

asset_modes.title: 2D Tiles
asset_modes.purpose: Tile/terrain refs for map and chunk layouts.

asset_modes.title: 2D Sprites
asset_modes.purpose: Actor, item and object sprite refs.

asset_modes.title: 2D Billboards
asset_modes.purpose: Sprite refs projected in pseudo-3D/first-person views.

asset_modes.title: 2D Wall Textures
asset_modes.purpose: Wall, floor and ceiling texture refs for first-person grid or sector worlds.

asset_modes.title: Portrait Cards
asset_modes.purpose: Character, NPC, enemy, party and faction portrait/card refs.

asset_modes.title: Generated Media Requests Only
asset_modes.purpose: Records future media requests without producing media.

asset_modes.title: 3D Models Later
asset_modes.purpose: Allows future 3D model refs without making them required now.

rules: Every game profile must choose explicit presentation, world topology, actor, inventory, combat, progression, pathfinding and NPC behavior ids.
Pseudo-3D from 2D assets is a first-class future target and must not require generated 3D models.
GamePackage stores data/contracts/refs, not Unity scene objects.
Media generation is outside this atlas; media request records and fallback ids are allowed.
